_notice: FICTIONAL. GRC records for Orrinwick Beacon. The author fills this file in by hand. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD. null means not done yet, so the matching check fails until you enter a date. Incidents are rated with the Potential Agency Impact N-rating (pain_rating, 0 to 5) and marked reportable to FedRAMP or not.

reviews.summary: Plan rewritten and approved as version 1.0: incidents rated with PAIN, reportability decided within 1 hour, and the reporting clock starts at the reportability decision (SD-006).
Review after failed change CHG-0412. The database migration had no tested rollback step. Added a rule that a migration must pass a rollback test in staging before it is released.

failed_or_emergency_changes.summary: Database migration failed in production and was rolled back by hand.

protection_reviews.summary: Annual review of WAF rules, rate limits and DDoS protection settings. No changes needed.

Review of protections after scope changes SC-001 (cross-region backup vault and on-demand recovery environment) and SC-002 (support-derived data on managed endpoints). Neither change adds an internet-facing entry point. The recovery environment has no standing resources and falls under the same protections when it is built (POL-RPL RPL-5). WAF rules, rate limits, load balancer listeners and threat detection stay as they are. No changes needed.
